title: Squirrel reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- squirrel body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#d9772e'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#f5c16c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='44' r='16' fill='#d9772e'/>
  <!-- inner face -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='47' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f5c16c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='31' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#d9772e'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='31' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#d9772e'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='32' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#f5c16c'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='32' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#f5c16c'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='3' fill='#2a0a3a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='43' r='3' fill='#2a0a3a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='42' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='49' r='1.8' fill='#8b3a0e'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 52 Q48 55 52 52' stroke='#8b3a0e' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- big fluffy tail -->
  <path d='M68 70 Q84 50 78 28 Q74 18 66 26 Q72 42 62 58 Z' fill='#c9621f'/>
  <path d='M68 68 Q80 52 76 34 Q73 24 68 30 Q72 44 64 58 Z' fill='#e89440'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#d9772e' transform='rotate(-20 38 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='62' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#d9772e' transform='rotate(20 58 62)'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g>
    <rect x='30' y='60' width='36' height='24' rx='2' fill='#3d86c6'/>
    <rect x='30' y='60' width='18' height='24' rx='2' fill='#4fa3e0'/>
    <rect x='48' y='60' width='18' height='24' rx='2' fill='#2f6ea8'/>
    <!-- page lines -->
    <line x1='34' y1='66' x2='45' y2='66' stroke='#f5f0d0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='70' x2='45' y2='70' stroke='#f5f0d0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='74' x2='43' y2='74' stroke='#f5f0d0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='66' x2='62' y2='66' stroke='#dfe9f5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='70' x2='62' y2='70' stroke='#dfe9f5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='51' y1='74' x2='60' y2='74' stroke='#dfe9f5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- spine -->
    <line x1='48' y1='60' x2='48' y2='84' stroke='#1c4d7a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='85' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#c9621f'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='85' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#c9621f'/>
</svg>
